scenario_description: A pinned Python repository builds and runs without touching the host workspace.
expected: Build commands, image identity, duration, exit status, stdout, and stderr are retained.
The host source tree is unchanged after execution.
The checked-out commit and behavior-bearing artifact match the requested experiment.
observed: SWE-ReX server reported 1.4.0 and Docker resolved the runtime to sha256:a75280f048abf533285cef78502df34118195fa678fc7a3ee2272356b7ddf4a6.
The source-identity command printed the requested commit 621e4974ca25ce531773def586ba3ed8e736b3fc exactly.
The package installation exited 0, the repository test named tests.test_simple.TestSimple.test_add_one passed, and the independent JSON artifact was input 41, expected 42, actual 42.
The host snapshot SHA-256 was identical before and after with no changed paths; Docker reported no remaining container after stop.
notes: Manually inspected command identities, exit statuses, stdout, stderr, behavior artifact, host hashes, runtime limits, and cleanup fields in the retained probe.
